purpose: Compile a proposed Feature candidate plus current source identities into a deterministic no-effect construction packet that names obligations, owners, held boundaries, proof classes and the next safe action without creating source or lifecycle authority.

sourceBindings.purpose: Canonical Feature candidate, scaffold, validation and review-lens derivation.
Canonical Intent Workgraph and progress truth.
Purpose Workspace, local Draft Surface, transaction currentness and construction-session provenance.
Presentation placement, containment, reachability and rendered-evidence obligations when human-visible UI is implicated.
Experience patterns, interaction forms, availability and action projection grammar.
Canonical action and permission/effect identities; this recipe never grants them.
Source-managed review-lens definitions used by the canonical Feature Registry derivation.
Repository orientation and canonical source-manifest currentness.
Existing no-authority implementation-packet precedent; FCF-07 does not replace its plan owner.

constructionStages.purpose: Ground current repository, canonical owners, source identities and held boundaries before any effect.
Form one explicit PROPOSED Feature candidate without canonical registry mutation.
Locate existing semantic, work, presentation, action, review and currentness owners before adding source.
Bind work/progress to canonical Intent Workgraph truth rather than a parallel progress store.
When human-visible UI is implicated, reuse semantic owners and Presentation Graph; otherwise record a reasoned N/A.
Bind canonical action/permission/effect semantics when behavior requires them; never infer authority from the packet.
Make localization, accessibility, recovery and environment obligations explicit for the affected feature.
Define exact authored/generated custody and held scope before source mutation.
Implement only after separate source authority, branch and claim are current.
Prove exact source and affected runtime/rendered behavior without upgrading evidence classes.
Run canonical affected review lenses and fresh claimless Independent Assurance.
Treat Formal Review, currentness, READY, merge and post-merge proof as distinct lifecycle effects.
Release exact writer custody only after accepted-main proof and return terminal evidence.

conditionalRules.disposition: 05_PLACE_HUMAN_SURFACE_AND_PRESENTATION_IF_NEEDED may be NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON and visual proof is not manufactured.

conditionalRules.condition: candidate effect class is definitively non-external
conditionalRules.disposition: No external-effect authority is created or requested by the packet.
Save, Deploy and Publish remain distinct held effects.
FCF-06 provenance relation is not forced into the feature.

conditionalRules.condition: one or more platformRefs are proposed
conditionalRules.disposition: Only separately proved platform behavior may be claimed conformant.

precedents.rule: Presentation adoption reuses existing semantic owners.
Project and Feature construction composes over Purpose Workspace.
Progress derives from canonical Intent Workgraph truth.
Draft Surface is local and noncanonical.
Draft mutations bind canonical action/effect/currentness and bounded receipts.
Construction provenance is a reference relation, not Journal or Memory mutation.
